_about: Who ran each survey, where and when: one fixed sentence per recipe (Background.render), kept apart from the condition, which holds only what respondents saw. Ruled 24 Nov 2026 (rich). Keyed by recipe file name; recipe.load() attaches the entry. Every fact carries its source; a recipe whose facts cannot all be found has no entry, never a guess. The export includes the field only when every exported row has one (CONVENTIONS, 'Background'). Ruled 24 Nov 2026 (rich): most ResearchBox and several other deposits never state the country or month of fielding, so 'every study' cannot be met without guessing. This file is therefore a sourced RECORD, kept for a later test of whether background helps; the export carries no background (rule A: only words respondents saw).
